_comment: Hand edits on top of the OpenStreetMap draft (scripts/stations/draft_from_osm.py), from the research pass of 2026-10-30 (data/stations/research/fi_OL).

sources.note: Laserkeilausaineisto 0,5 p, © Maanmittauslaitos, CC BY 4.0: building and roof heights and the ground (3D research pass; pack in data/stations/research/fi_OL).

changelog.what: First draft from OSM with the research pass's platform numbers, entrances, heights and amenities.

Platform heights from Digitraffic infra-api platforms (Fintraffic/Väylävirasto, CC BY 4.0); 3 buildings, roofs and footbridges with laser heights; the ground as a 5 m grid (3D research pass, data/stations/research/fi_OL).

1._source: Digitraffic infra-api platforms (Fintraffic/Väylävirasto, CC BY 4.0), Digitraffic infra-api laiturit 1.2.246.586.1.37.3183754, read 2026-10-30, CC BY 4.0: tracks 1, class korkea = 0.55 m above rail, 368 m long; a recorded design class, not a survey

structures.name: apartments
structures._source: Outline OSM w1460220552 (ODbL); roof = median of 21 unclassified laser points >2 m above the terrain model inside the outline; Laserkeilausaineisto 0,5 p, newest per sheet (clack_fi_mml05_R4414A2), Maanmittauslaitos (National Land Survey of Finland), CC BY 4.0; scanned R4414A2 2023-06-14 (20230206_Swissphoto_Oulu_kesa); from data/stations/research/fi_OL/oulu_structures_heights.geojson (metres above the platform surface, 12.65 m RH 2000, laser 2023-06-14)

structures.name: roof over the platforms (traced from the laser)
structures._source: Outline traced from the laser alone (1 m cells holding unclassified points 2.4–14 m above the platform surface over the BanInfo platforms, outside OSM outlines, closed 3×3, simplified 0.7 m); Laserkeilausaineisto 0,5 p, newest per sheet (clack_fi_mml05_R4414A2), Maanmittauslaitos (National Land Survey of Finland), CC BY 4.0; scanned R4414A2 2023-06-14 (20230206_Swissphoto_Oulu_kesa); from data/stations/research/fi_OL/oulu_structures_heights.geojson (metres above the platform surface, 12.65 m RH 2000, laser 2023-06-14); underside not measured
